baselineSummary.title: Leaderboard | Ocentra Games
baselineSummary.textHead: Dev Ocentra Games public page Leaderboard View the overall Ocentra leaderboard across supported games and competitive score tracks. Primary Ocentra Game Areas Card Games Catalog Browse researched card game rules, deck notes, history, categories, and playable Ocentra pilots. Trick-taking Card Games Explore trick-taking games with rules, deck systems, player counts, and migration status. Competition Track Ocentra competitive formats, tournament paths, leaderboard surfaces, and AI benchmark context. Events Browse seasonal campaigns that connect shop access, tournament entries, benchmark challenges, and rewards. Tournaments Follow Ocentra tournament formats, schedules, eligibility, and prize-track pages. Leaderboard View Ocentra competitive score tracks across supported games and leaderboard formats. Playable Card Game Pilots Claim Claim is a tactical four-player card game about declarations, stock timing, debt, and aggressive showdown decisions. Briscola Briscola is an Italian trick-taking card game adapted for the Ocentra game catalog. Three Card Brag Three Card Brag is a compact card game centered on betting pressure and short-hand comparison.
